content:
With the Liquid Glass redesign officially rolling out to most iOS WhatsApp users, the messaging platform is now testing another visual change, this time focusing on the look of chat bubbles. Here's what's new.

The new chat bubbles appear more rounded

Months ago, WhatsApp finally rolled out its Liquid Glass redesign more broadly, after months of testing and fine-tuning the new look with select users via TestFlight.

Around the same time, WABetaInfo spotted clues in the app's code pointing to a redesign of WhatsApp's chat bubbles. The site now reports that the new bubble design is beginning to roll out to some users on the latest TestFlight build.

Here's what WABetaInfo says:

Beyond changing the shape of message bubbles, the new design also changes how media and links appear in conversations. WhatsApp has removed the green border around them, making photos, videos, GIFs, and link previews look cleaner and more unified.

According to WABetaInfo, the new look is currently only available to some users on the WhatsApp TestFlight build. There's no word yet on when it will roll out more broadly to all iOS users.
